<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="18" y="19" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="17" x2="326" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="331" y2="10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="17" x2="336" y2="8" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="17" x2="341" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="12" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="15" x2="348" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="7" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="9" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#15451F"/>
    <rect x="383" y="10" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="60" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="30,58 22,64 30,70" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="68" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="22px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your trip</text>
    <circle cx="356" cy="59" r="12" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <text x="356" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">1/3</text>
    <rect x="16" y="80" width="358" height="8" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="16" y="80" width="119" height="8" rx="64" fill="#FFC800"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Intro travel prompt -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="105" width="358" height="116" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="103" width="358" height="116" rx="14" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <rect x="30" y="118" width="78" height="58" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="56" y="118" width="26" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="30" y="134" width="78" height="8.5" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="132" r="3" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <polygon points="45,166 58,145 69,157 79,148 97,166" fill="#9DAD88"/>
    <circle cx="87" cy="132" r="5" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="126" y="131" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="900" fill="#15451F">YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE</text>
    <text x="126" y="153" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Learn French for your trip</text>
    <text x="126" y="175" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#456B64">A little practice goes a long way.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="126" y="184" width="116" height="25" rx="13" fill="#1899D6"/>
      <text x="184" y="201" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">LET’S DO IT!</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination section -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="249" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="18" y="270" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">We’ll tailor your practice to the places you’ll visit.</text>

    <text x="18" y="296" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">DESTINATION</text>
    <rect x="16" y="304" width="358" height="50" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="16" y="302" width="358" height="50" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="39" cy="326" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="332" x2="51" y2="338" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="61" y="333" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Search a city or country</text>
    <text x="18" y="369" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Try “Paris”, “Nice”, or “France”</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Dates section -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="400" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">When is your trip?</text>
    <text x="18" y="421" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Set dates to make a plan that fits your schedule.</text>
    <text x="18" y="447" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">TRAVEL DATES</text>

    <rect x="16" y="455" width="170" height="52" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="16" y="453" width="170" height="52" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="32" y="468" width="18" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="32" y1="473" x2="50" y2="473" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="37" y1="464" x2="37" y2="470" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="464" x2="45" y2="470" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="63" y="485" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Start date</text>

    <rect x="204" y="455" width="170" height="52" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="204" y="453" width="170" height="52" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="220" y="468" width="18" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="220" y1="473" x2="238" y2="473" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="225" y1="464" x2="225" y2="470" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="233" y1="464" x2="233" y2="470" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="251" y="485" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">End date</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Activities -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="539" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">What will you do?</text>
    <text x="18" y="560" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose activities you’d like to feel ready for.</text>

    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="577" width="112" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="596" r="9" fill="#FFC800"/>
      <polyline points="31,596 35,600 42,591" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="53" y="602" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Dining</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="139" y="577" width="116" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="159" cy="596" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="176" y="602" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Sightseeing</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="266" y="577" width="108" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="286" cy="596" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="303" y="602" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Shopping</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="624" width="118" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="36" cy="643" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="53" y="649" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Transport</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="145" y="624" width="112" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="165" cy="643" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="182" y="649" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Meeting locals</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="268" y="624" width="106" height="38" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="288" cy="643" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#C9C7C7" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="305" y="649" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Other</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="684" width="358" height="48" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="682" width="358" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="712" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="754" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change these details anytime.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <polygon points="39,799 51,789 63,799" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="43" y="798" width="16" height="14" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="51" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">LEARN</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <circle cx="137" cy="798" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="137,792 139,798 144,801" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="137" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PRACTICE</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <circle cx="253" cy="796" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="253" cy="807" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="253" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">PROFILE</text>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.55">
      <circle cx="345" cy="794" r="2" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="345" cy="801" r="2" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <circle cx="345" cy="808" r="2" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="345" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">MORE</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
